name: Rub Some Dirt In It
summary: A worried companion asks you to gather untainted soil near Mount Hyjal. The soil will be mixed into poultices for Fraxinus, who is sick.

sections.title: Soil for Fraxinus
sections.body: Near Mount Hyjal, a companion is tending to a sick friend named Fraxinus. You are asked to gather untainted soil so poultices can be made to help him feel better. The soil gathers beneath shaded trees on the valley’s south side, where rainwater runs down the slopes.

faq.answer: Fraxinus, the companion’s friend, is sick.
The companion needs untainted soil to make poultices for Fraxinus.

faq.q: Where can I find the soil?
faq.answer: The soil collects beneath shaded trees on the south side of the valley near Mount Hyjal.

faq.q: What will the soil be used for?
faq.answer: The companion plans to mix the soil into poultices to help Fraxinus feel better.
